name: ddp-tracker-assets
description: Static assets for ddp-tracker. Sass source lives in assets/scss/ (Bootstrap 5.3 compiled in, from node_modules) and compiles to static/css/; htmx and Bootstrap's JS bundle are copied from node_modules to static/vendor/ (served same-origin for the CSP). Rebuilt by `npm run build`.

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:vendor
scripts.build:vendor: mkdir -p ddp_tracker/static/vendor && cp node_modules/htmx.org/dist/htmx.min.js ddp_tracker/static/vendor/htmx.min.js && cp node_modules/bootstrap/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js ddp_tracker/static/vendor/bootstrap.bundle.min.js
